Hi Tom — thanks for flagging this. Short answer: the June 30, 2026 PDF is the reissued Type II. Longer explanation below and I've looped in Rishi (Security) and Soojin (Compliance) to confirm exact wording for the evidence packet.

What happened: during final packaging our auditor corrected a minor control identifier and reissued the report with a new report ID; the underlying audit period and scope are unchanged (services: Redwood inference API, control groups: CC1-CC7 as listed). We did not remove services.

What to use: please reference the 2026-06-30 reissue PDF we uploaded. We will provide a short bridge letter clarifying that the reissue is administrative (report ID update) and that the audit period remains Jan 1, 2025 — Jun 30, 2026.

I'll follow up with the bridge letter and the signed reissue copy by end of day. If your intake call is sooner and you need interim wording, say so and I can send a one-paragraph note you can attach.

Best,
